title: Chapter 456 Reinforcements Arrive
content:
Chapter 456 Reinforcements Arrive

Seeing a woman covered in blood, holding a sword, and a cold-faced look rushed towards her with murderous intent, the priest was stunned at first, and then covered in anger.

"So brave!"

laugh!

The sword light came, and the priest waved his hand and a divine light shot out, colliding with the sword light.

Rumble!

Facing Lu Xue's firepower was fully opened and there was no longer any suppression. Even the priests from the land of Gods took action personally, they were just fighting hard to part.

Seeing Lu Xue's extremely terrifying combat power, the other strong people in the land of the gods were all frightened.

Especially the two Divine Eye and the Scythei, they have been fighting against such an opponent before. If the opponent directly attacks, they may not be able to withstand it.

Immediately afterwards, several terrifying strong men appeared on the Land of Gods, all of whom were not weaker than those of priests, and after joining the battlefield.

The scene suddenly showed a one-sided situation.

"Damn it, I don't show my power. I really think I'm a reptile!"

Ao Qing roared, and his body expanded rapidly. Soon, the entire battlefield was spanned by a nine-clawed dragon emitting golden light.

With every time Ao Qing twisted his body, the army of the gods would be defeated and repelled.

But what is welcomed is the joint efforts of the powerful people in the land of the gods.

The sword light, spear light, and fist seals were countless, and the colorful offensives washed towards Ao Qing, flooding them all.

Soon, his skin was as hard as Ao Qing was beaten so hard that his skin was blooming and screaming.

But even so, Ao Qing still stood firm and fought for opportunities for the powerful people in the Chaos Realm.

"Hmph, it's just that trapped beasts are still fighting."

The land of the gods is still full of confidence.

Immediately afterwards, abnormal movements occurred on the black hole again.

Another group of strong men came out of the black hole, bringing endless despair to the Chaos Realm.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue looked angry, "It's too much to deceive others. Do you think you are the only ones?"

Lu Xue pointed at the sky with a sword and roared angrily, "Where are the people in the deserted city?"

Immediately afterwards, the strong men in the deserted city responded with a stern voice.

However, this is not finished.

In the boundless starry sky, countless familiar sounds came and poured into the battlefield, shaking all living beings.

"Born as a man in the desert city, and die as a ghost in the desert city!"

laugh!

Suddenly, a faint light emerged from the end of the galaxy. It was originally just a white dot, but as time passed, the white dot became bigger and bigger, and soon turned into a dazzling ray of light hormone.

Buzz —

Suddenly, the entire battlefield was covered with white light, extremely dazzling.

It was not until this time that everyone realized that this was actually a terrifying sword light.

A white light flashed, and when everyone opened their eyes again, the entire battlefield had been slashed in half by a sword, and the sword marks stood in the starry sky and remained undispersed for a long time.

The terrifying sword intent raged, causing all living beings to stop.

Da da da da da.

A crisp sound of footsteps came.

Everyone looked towards the end of the galaxy and saw a figure taking a relaxed pace towards this side. As he took a step forward, he immediately appeared in the battlefield.

The man was wearing a gray robe, holding a three-foot sword in his hand, with a starry eyebrow and a smile on his mouth.

Everyone looked at the man and felt a sharp aura.

The man glanced at the audience and finally stopped at Lu Xue, "Miss Lu Xue, I'm not late, right?"

Lu Xue had a bright smile, but her eyes were a little rosy.

The Waste Guard!

The sword-holder in the desert city is the first barrier in the desert city.

The priest in the Land of Gods looked solemn, and looking at the deserted city, he also felt a great sense of oppression.

He opened his mouth to speak, and at this moment, another strange movement came from the depths of the starry sky.

"After the order of the Lord of the City, we will wipe out the gods!"

The majestic voice came, which shocked all the Huangwei present, and then tears filled his eyes.

The leader is back!

The sword flashed by, and a middle-aged man in a dark gold robe appeared. The long sword around his waist sounded slightly, and an unstoppable momentum rushed to the battlefield.

The leader of the deserted city and the deserted guards.

Lu Daosheng's capable general, A Wei!

Lu Xue looked at Awei and felt completely at peace.

What kind of gods are the land of gods, what kind of gods are just the native chicken Vago.

Feeling Lu Xue's gaze, Awei looked at Lu Xue with a smile on his face, "Miss, don't worry, there's still there."

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue knew it.

Sure enough, the next moment, a wanton laughter spread throughout the battlefield.

"Hahahaha, how dare you touch my deserted city?"

A domineering fist light broke through the void and made a terrifying gap.

Immediately afterwards, a figure broke out from it and entered the battlefield.

"Master!"

Lu Xue looked a little excited, looking at Gu Chen with tears in her eyes.

Gu Chen also looked at Lu Xue and whispered: "Don't worry, Xiaoxue, we will call you back one by one for you if you are wronged."

Hearing this, Lu Xue felt relieved and nodded.

At this moment, the priest's face was extremely ugly. The sudden appearance of the terrifying powerful man made him feel unsure, but the god behind him gave him confidence.

Then he snorted coldly and said, "Do you think you can shake my gods' land? The reason why the land of gods is called the land of gods is not because of us, but the gods."

"A group of ants also want to defeat the gods. I advise you to surrender as soon as possible and don't do any useless efforts."

As soon as Shen Guan finished speaking, a black shadow suddenly appeared behind him without warning.

"Have you said enough? If you say enough, go to die."

laugh!

The priest's face suddenly solidified, and the next moment, a blood thread appeared out of thin air from his neck.

Immediately afterwards, a man walked out of the dark shadow, lifted the priest's head with one hand, and smiled loudly, "Today is the day when the gods fall!"

An Xing!

The leader of this root organization is now revealed in everyone's eyes again.

But everyone knew nothing about An Xing.

But at this moment, An Xing's figure was infinitely elevated in the hearts of everyone in the Chaos Realm.

In contrast, in the land of the gods, looking at the head of the priest who was carried like garbage, his eyes were filled with fear.

"Sir, I'm dead."

The crazy expression of the schizartaki froze, and she said blankly.

On the side, the hands behind the divine eyes were trembling wildly.

At this moment, he suddenly understood Luo Carrot's last words before.

But he can't leave.

This is the command of the god, and once he gives up his mission, he will die.

So in the end, his fate was already destined.

With a plop, the divine eyes sat down in dismay, with despair in their eyes.

The vast army of gods did not have the initial rush at this moment, but it was still a considerable force.

A strong man from the Land of Gods fought back, and his madness was beyond words.

Suddenly, the whole world of the gods became crazy.

Their brainwashed by gods, and the price of getting powerful power is that they are easily confused and fall into madness.

The entire starry sky was suddenly filled with a large army.

And at this moment, a grand aura swept over, like a thousand troops.
